decision_assessment.why: The latest rule places Product and concrete Aspects in actual PROJECT STRUCTURE and leaves MODEL with only Aspect, but it does not identify which concrete Project-structure Aspect, if any, replaces the 47-source legacy Product Aspect subject. CA-R-2256 and CA-C-620 separately retain the named Framework Continuant/product identity. Mapping every Product reference to Continuant would conflate an Aspect subject with the Framework object; mapping it to an unspecified Project-structure Aspect would invent a target.
decision_assessment.safe_now: Keep CA-R-2256's named Continuant identity distinct; inventory and later map the 47 legacy Product Aspect consumers only after a named actual PROJECT STRUCTURE Product Aspect (or an explicit decision that no such Aspect exists) is established.
